description: This file defines a middleware class for the Slim framework that ensures the 'Content-Length' header is added to responses if it is not already present, based on the size of the response body.

classes.name: ContentLengthMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for automatically adding Content-Length headers to HTTP responses within the Slim framework.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the incoming server request, invokes the next handler, and appends the Content-Length header if necessary.
